methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The performance indexes are very simple and have been defined only with the purpose of showing the advantages of distributed generation.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Renewable-energy-system case report: describes a hybrid PV-wind-battery installation, compares two battery-storage control logics (System Led vs Market Led) under Time-of-Use tariffs, and evaluates simple energy/economic/CO2/peak-reduction saving indexes defined only to show distributed-generation advantages. No EnPI/EnB energy-performance-measurement model (no consumption normalisation against relevant variables, no energy baseline, no SEC/regression) is presented; context is an offices building and the core is economic battery management. NB the paper's 'ENPI' denotes the EU Italy-Tunisia funding programme (European Neighbourhood & Partnership Instrument), not an Energy Performance Indicator.

paper_type.evidence_quote: installed at the administrative offices building of the municipality of Valderice (Italy)

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility. Simple saving indexes (EnS/EcS/CO2R/PPR) only; no EnPI/EnB baseline/normalisation model. NB paper's 'ENPI' = EU Italy-Tunisia funding programme, not Energy Performance Indicator. Flag for human blind-first review.
